1.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,

2.translation: and I swear by the self-reproaching soul[1]!
2.footnotes: [1] Of the believer, which blames oneself whenever falls into sin or error.

3.translation: Does man think that We cannot reassemble his bones?

4.translation: In fact, We are able to restore even his very fingertips.

5.translation: But man desires to persist in sin[2],
5.footnotes: [2] While denying the coming of the Day of Judgment.

6.translation: and asks [mockingly], “When is the Day of Resurrection?”

7.translation: But when the sight is dazzled,

9.translation: and the sun and the moon are brought together[3],
9.footnotes: [3] They both have never been together since they were created. On this Day they will be brought together, darkened, and both will be thrown into the Hell; so that all should know that they were subservient created beings, especially those who worshiped them.

10.translation: on that Day man will say, “Where is the escape?”

11.translation: No indeed! There will be no refuge.

12.translation: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.

13.translation: On that Day man will be informed of what he has sent forth[4] and left behind[5].
13.footnotes:
[4] i.e., of his deeds for the Hereafter.
 [5] i.e., that which he failed to do.

14.translation: In fact, man will be a witness against himself[6],
14.footnotes: [6] His organs will testify against him, as mentioned in 36:65 and 41:20-23.

15.translation: despite the excuses he may put forward.

16.translation: Do not move your tongue [O Prophet] in haste trying to memorize it.

17.translation: It is upon Us to make you memorize and recite it.

18.translation: Then when We recite it [through Gabriel], follow its recitation attentively;

19.translation: then it is upon Us to explain its meanings.

20.translation: No indeed! You [people] love this fleeting world,

22.translation: On that Day some faces will be bright,

23.footnotes: [7] The dwellers of Paradise will be granted the honor of actually seeing their Lord in the Hereafter.

24.translation: And on that Day, some faces will be gloomy,

25.translation: knowing that a crushing calamity will befall them.

26.translation: Indeed, when the soul reaches the throat[8],

27.translation: and it is said, “Is there any healer?”

28.translation: And he realizes that it is time to depart,

29.translation: when legs are brought together [in a shroud][9];
29.footnotes: [9] The difficulties the person faces while leaving this world and moving on to the Hereafter; or the people arrange for the departure of his body, while angels arrange for the departure of his soul.

30.translation: on that Day, he will be driven to your Lord.

32.translation: rather he denied and turned away,

33.translation: then he went to his people, elated with pride,

35.translation: Again, woe to you, and woe!

36.translation: Does man think that he will be left neglected[10]?
36.footnotes: [10] i.e., without purpose and responsibility, or without returning to Allah for account.

37.translation: Was he not once a drop of semen emitted,

38.translation: then he became a clinging clot[11], then He created him and perfected his form,
38.footnotes: [11] "‘Alaqah": an embryo that resembles a leech.

39.translation: and made from him both genders, male and female?

40.translation: Is not He able to bring the dead back to life?
